_comment: Biome variants (worldgen expansion phase 3), read by tools/worldgen/build_variants.py and build_preset.py. A variant copies its base biome and changes only what is listed: temperature, downfall, colours (any of the biome's effects), thin_trees (keeps one tree in N), add_features (step -> placed features), remove_features, boulders (per chunk; default: the base's), surface (river and edge ground, in build_preset.py). Peaks: the ground above y. Edges: where the base meets one of the neighbours, about 32 blocks in. Rivers: the river that runs through the listed land.
_pool_seeds: Each parent's sub-biome pool draws from its own seed. Never change one, or give a parent with sub-biomes already in worlds a new one: its sub-biomes would all move. A new parent, or a later round of one ("parent#2"), takes the next free number.

subs._comment: Sub-biomes (worldgen expansion phase 6): each takes over part of its parent ('base') as whole biome areas, about one parent cell (256 blocks) in 'share', or ('shore_of') the beach where those lands meet the sea. Same keys as the variants, plus spawns (group -> mob -> weight, or {weight, minCount, maxCount}; 0 removes) and effects (colours). Trees: remove the parent's tree feature and add one of 'features' below; the biome's tree table (data/eternalreturn/eternalreturn/tree_tables/sub_*.json) picks each tree's species.

features._comment: The sub-biomes' own features (a water lake is 16 blocks wide from its spot and reads the biome all over it: it is shifted back 8, or it reads past the chunks it may and generation crashes): name -> feature (a configured feature id, or one written out here) and placement (a list, or a shorthand: trees, patch or scatter; see build_variants.py). Written to worldgen/configured_feature/sub/ and worldgen/placed_feature/sub/. A tree feature only sets where trees stand: the biome's tree table picks each one's species by its wood.

caves._comment: Cave biomes (phase 6, ice caves): under the land the build_preset.py rule names (snowy biomes and frozen seas), at least 8 blocks below the surface, where Moderner Beta's cave biome map (caveBiomeSettings: a Voronoi pattern of points, 'share' of them this biome) says so. Each is a variant of 'base' for its tags.
